metadata.name: Atomic Court
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A tiny cul-de-sac in the desert: two two-storey houses face each other across a street blocked by a school bus and a truck, each with a garage, a lawn and a fenced backyard. Fast and close, for 2–12 players; the flags are in the backyards and King of the Hill moves between the bus and the two upstairs landings.
